title: Customer audit intake playbook and one-click evidence bundles
creator: Aisha Rao
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers frequently open compliance requests (audits, DSARs, DPA fulfillment) that require curated evidence packages: data residency attestations, retention snapshots, access logs, encryption/KMS configs, and DPA language. Current process is ad-hoc: SEs manually assemble artifacts from Confluence, S3 snapshots, and infra dashboards. That creates long response times, risks inconsistent artifacts, and high engineering lift.

Goal: Build an intake + orchestration flow that (1) guides customers/CS through a standardized compliance request playbook, (2) automates assembly of an evidence bundle (region-specific residency, retention settings, exportable audit logs, DPA template with tenant data), and (3) exposes a one-click export and audit-readiness report for customers and internal legal/security reviewers. The bundle should be cryptographically signed and include provenance metadata to reduce back-and-forth with auditors.

Out of scope for this ticket: full RBAC for private deployments and on-prem artifacts; those are tracked as follow-ups. This scope focuses on hosted + Dedicated customers initially.
acceptance_criteria: Intake UI: a guided form in Console that captures request type, scope (customers/accounts), date ranges, residency constraints, and NDA/DPA requirements

Evidence orchestration backend: playbook engine that runs a configurable sequence (fetch residency attestations, retention snapshot, audit logs, KMS key metadata, config export) and produces a single ZIP bundle
One-click export: Console button to generate and download signed evidence bundle (PKCS7 or similar) and store an immutable copy in a customer-owned S3 path if configured
Audit report: human-readable summary (PDF) that maps each artifact to controls (e.g., ISO/ SOC 2) and a machine-readable index (JSON) listing artifact provenance and generation timestamps
Security review: design reviewed and approved by security team (links to review notes) before GA
Observability: metrics and tracing for export duration, artifact generation errors, and per-customer rate limits. Alerts on failures > 5%
Documentation: Confluence playbook for SE/CS with troubleshooting steps and standard response SLAs
E2E test: automated test that simulates a residency + retention request and validates bundle contents and signature
